children: Pluri agreed to grant ZEO ScientifiX an exclusive U.S. license to manufacture and commercialize its regenerative medicine portfolio, in a partnership that could expand into Latin America. Pluri is expected to own 50% of ZEO following the contemplated share issuances and receive preferred shares representing 51% of ZEO's voting power, subject to closing conditions. Separately, Pluri agreed to raise $1 million from two investment firms through share sales and warrants, with proceeds intended for corporate development, general corporate purposes and working capital.
